description: Java class defining a REST controller for bank account operations within a Spring Boot application. Handles account retrieval, creation, transfer, and transaction listing through mapped HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST controller for account and transaction operations using Spring Web annotations. Facilitates CRUD and transfer actions for bank accounts.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve account details based on account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new bank account for a specific customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to perform fund transfer between accounts for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve list of transactions for a given account number.
